The '''Tantive Gallery of Progressive Art''' was an art museum on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tantive IV (planet)|Tantive IV]]. Its "sister" museum was the [[Aldera Museum of Modern Expression]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
